$comment: cat-result/1. Structured output of POST /v1/categorise (docs/03-technical/llm-categorise.md section 3): index-based, so no merchant name is echoed and no free text exists. RUNTIME INJECTION: $defs/CategoryCode.enum is a default only. The backend rebuilds it per catalog version from the live system top-level category codes plus 'unknown' (custom categories are never sent) and caches the result; the list here is the 16 seeded codes. i is the zero-based index of the merchant in the request, at most 20 per call (cat.batch_max, which may be lowered by remote config but never raised above 20 without a new schema); the backend checks range and uniqueness itself (step 6 of the server order) because uniqueItems is not used. p is the model's confidence 0..100. PROVIDER KEYWORD SUBSET: type, properties, required, additionalProperties:false, enum, $defs/$ref, minimum, maximum, minItems, maxItems only; no oneOf, allOf, not, const, uniqueItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format. Exceptions: $schema, $id and this $comment are stripped before sending. Anthropic ignores minimum/maximum/maxItems (an adapter moves them into descriptions; the backend validation is authoritative). max_output_tokens = 25 * n + 20 for a batch of n names.
